parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: ID of the user. `me` is also accepted for the signed-in user

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Relations to add to the answer: `permissions` adds the user's permission levels

description:
Returns one user. `GET /users/me` returns the signed-in user, with its own `goaccess` and `monitoring` flags. An API token may read only its own user (`me` or its owner's id); for any other user it is refused with 403.

Needs: a signed-in session (or an API token for its own user); reading another user needs an administrator session
